entries.message: 这个是我们的新产品 playworld，前面的novel.ai就不做了 页面中就不要再有novel.ai了 我们现在全部都是dnd了，也就是playworld。你把页面重新修改一下 我看还有novel.ai
entries.rationale: Use the official Steam spelling Playworlds for future product positioning and remove NovelAI from new page copy and CTAs. Treat D&D only as an adult tabletop audience/search reference without official, licensed, endorsed, or 5e-compatible claims. Preserve historical artifacts and keep the site-wide migration blocked until the Playworlds CTA, attribution callback, and replacement production domain/GSC property are implemented and verified.
